aiMetadata.description: Launches an autonomous AI web-navigation agent that starts at a given URL and pursues a free-text goal (e.g. find a price, extract a fact, locate a page), then blocks polling until the task completes or a 15-minute timeout elapses, returning the agent's text output. Choose it when a task requires live, multi-step browsing of a website rather than a single fixed API call or scrape. Requires a starting URL and a goal; each call spins up a fresh browsing run, so it is not idempotent.
